title: Pretrained Time-Series Foundation Models for Financial Return Forecasting
method: Benchmarks pretrained TSFMs against train-from-scratch models under equalized context and rolling-origin evaluation.
data: AAPL, AMZN, GOOG, JPM, META daily returns.
key_result: TSFMs won 8/10 task rankings, but gains over random walk were small and sparse; only two Diebold–Mariano tests rejected equal/inferior accuracy.
stated_limitation: Five equities only; no universal alpha claim, transaction costs, or live deployment test.

title: Nexus: An Agentic Framework for Time Series Forecasting
method: Decomposes forecasts into macro and micro temporal reasoning, contextual retrieval, and synthesis by specialized agents.
data: Zillow metrics and volatile stock-market equities after LLM knowledge cutoffs.
key_result: Reportedly matches or outperforms TSFMs and LLM baselines on post-cutoff sets.
stated_limitation: No calibrated uncertainty, transaction costs, or controlled contamination audit in the abstract.

title: Bridging the Last Mile of Time Series Forecasting with LLM Agents
method: Adds retrieval, constrained forecast revision, long-horizon decomposition, and memory reflection on a forecasting backbone.
data: Real-world business case studies.
key_result: Shows case-study evidence that agents can turn statistical forecasts into business-ready revisions.
stated_limitation: Case studies rather than a standardized contamination-resistant benchmark.

title: LLM-based Agents for Forecasting and Prediction: Methods, Training, Evaluation, and Applications
method: Reviews standalone, retrieval/tool-augmented, and hybrid forecasting agents and evaluation protocols.
data: Finance, weather, health, energy, and operations benchmarks.
key_result: Identifies calibration under shift, contamination-resistant live evaluation, cost reporting, and feedback loops as unresolved.
stated_limitation: The review explicitly states that measurement and contamination remain limiting factors.

title: MIRAI: Evaluating LLM Agents for Event Forecasting
method: Introduces APIs for retrieving structured events and news before predicting future international events.
data: GDELT-derived relational event tasks and historical news.
key_result: Evaluates source integration, code/tool use, and temporal event reasoning across horizons.
stated_limitation: Targets international events rather than financial returns; no economic utility test.

title: Time-Series Forecasting for Out-of-Distribution Generalization Using Invariant Learning
method: Infers temporal environments and learns invariant representations with a surrogate loss for OOD forecasting.
data: Multiple public forecasting datasets with covariates.
key_result: Reports gains up to 85% and uniform improvements across evaluated backbones.
stated_limitation: Focuses on univariate targets with covariates; unobserved causes and missing environment labels remain challenges.

title: Handling Concept Drift in Global Time Series
method: Studies transfer-learning and concept-drift handling for global forecasting models as distributions change.
data: Four global time-series datasets plus statistical and LightGBM baselines.
key_result: Shows drift-aware transfer can improve forecasting under changing distributions.
stated_limitation: Not financial or agentic; authors frame global-forecasting drift handling as underdeveloped.

title: Foundation Models for Time Series Analysis: A Tutorial and Survey
method: Taxonomizes TSFM architectures, pretraining, adaptation, and modalities.
data: Public TSFM literature and benchmarks.
key_result: Provides a methodology-centric map of TSFMs.
stated_limitation: Mechanisms and evaluation remain unsettled; no contamination-controlled financial benchmark.

title: Chronos: Learning the Language of Time Series
method: Scales, quantizes, and tokenizes values, then trains T5-style language models for probabilistic forecasting.
data: 42 public datasets plus Gaussian-process synthetic data.
key_result: Outperforms methods on seen datasets and is competitive or occasionally superior zero-shot on unseen datasets.
stated_limitation: Benchmark overlap and no finance-specific economic evaluation complicate deployment claims.

title: Unified Training of Universal Time Series Forecasting Transformers
method: Uses masked encoder pretraining, flexible patch sizes, and mixture distributions for universal forecasting.
data: LOTSA: over 27B observations across nine domains.
key_result: Competitive or superior zero-shot performance versus full-shot models.
stated_limitation: Financial regime shifts and post-deployment drift are not tested.

title: A Decoder-Only Foundation Model for Time-Series Forecasting
method: Pretrains a patched decoder-only Transformer on a large real and synthetic time-series corpus.
data: Large internal corpus and public benchmark datasets.
key_result: Reports zero-shot performance close to supervised state of the art.
stated_limitation: External users cannot fully audit training-data overlap; finance robustness is not the focus.

title: TimeGPT-1
method: Presents a proprietary pretrained Transformer for zero-shot forecasting across domains.
data: Diverse public and proprietary time-series datasets.
key_result: Reports strong zero-shot accuracy, efficiency, and simplicity.
stated_limitation: Closed-source model limits reproducibility and contamination/calibration audits.

title: Time-MoE: Billion-Scale Time Series Foundation Models with Mixture of Experts
method: Trains a sparse mixture-of-experts TSFM with conditional computation.
data: Large multi-domain pretraining collection and public benchmarks.
key_result: Reports strong scaling and transfer while activating only a subset of experts.
stated_limitation: Scale and training cost make independent reproduction difficult; finance-specific evaluation is not central.

title: Time-LLM: Time Series Forecasting by Reprogramming Large Language Models
method: Reprograms numerical patches into textual prototypes and feeds them to a frozen LLM.
data: ETT, electricity, traffic, weather, and exchange-rate benchmarks.
key_result: Reports gains over prior methods on several benchmarks without updating the LLM.
stated_limitation: No live news grounding, regime-shift, or financial decision-utility evaluation.

title: A Time Series is Worth 64 Words: Long-term Forecasting with Transformers
method: Segments histories into patches and uses channel-independent Transformer encoding.
data: ETT, electricity, traffic, weather, and exchange rate.
key_result: Improves long-term accuracy versus Transformer baselines while reducing attention cost.
stated_limitation: Channel independence limits explicit cross-series interaction; no news or regime-shift setting.

title: iTransformer: Inverted Transformers Are Effective for Time Series Forecasting
method: Embeds each variate as a token and applies attention across variates.
data: Seven real-world long-term forecasting datasets.
key_result: Reports state-of-the-art results and improved multivariate representation quality.
stated_limitation: No uncertainty, evidence provenance, or event-aware finance tests.

title: Are Transformers Effective for Time Series Forecasting?
method: Uses simple linear and decomposed-linear mappings as strong long-horizon baselines.
data: Nine real-life datasets: ETT, traffic, electricity, exchange rate, weather, ILI.
key_result: LTSF-Linear often outperformed sophisticated Transformers.
stated_limitation: Result is strongest for long-horizon benchmark settings; no multimodal evidence or probabilistic calibration.

title: Temporal Fusion Transformers for Interpretable Multi-horizon Time Series Forecasting
method: Combines recurrent local processing, variable selection, gating, and interpretable attention.
data: Retail, electricity, and traffic-style datasets.
key_result: Outperformed strong baselines while providing variable-selection and attention views.
stated_limitation: Authors caution that attention/importance is not causal explanation; no live news or regime-shift validation.

title: N-HiTS: Neural Hierarchical Interpolation for Time Series Forecasting
method: Uses hierarchical interpolation and multi-rate sampling for long-horizon forecasts.
data: Large-scale long-horizon benchmark datasets.
key_result: Reports almost 20% average improvement over recent Transformers and up to 50x lower computation.
stated_limitation: Assumes smooth multi-scale structure; no textual evidence or abrupt financial shocks.

title: Long-term Forecasting with TiDE: Time-series Dense Encoder
method: Uses an MLP encoder-decoder with covariate projection and residual temporal decoding.
data: Long-term forecasting benchmarks with static and dynamic covariates.
key_result: Matches or outperforms Transformers and is reported 5–10x faster.
stated_limitation: Guarantees concern linear dynamical systems; no news, calibration, or financial-regime evaluation.

title: Conformalized Quantile Regression
method: Calibrates conditional quantile models with conformal residual corrections for finite-sample coverage.
data: Synthetic and benchmark regression datasets.
key_result: Provides marginal coverage guarantees with adaptive interval widths.
stated_limitation: Coverage is marginal/exchangeability-based and can fail under temporal dependence or shift without adaptation.
